verdict.rationale: HeyGen's own docs claim cross-shot character consistency: reusable avatars and digital twins keep a "consistent identity", the homepage promises wide, medium and close-up shots that are "all consistent", and cinematic avatars support multi-shot prompts. This is consistency across shots, not just a reference input. Video Agent scene revision also keeps untouched scenes' visuals. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-shot consistency, documentation of scene/environment consistency (as opposed to avatar identity) across separately generated clips, technical depth on how consistency is maintained in multi-shot cinematic prompts.

support.subject: As a creator, a character or scene stays consistent across multiple generated shots, not just within one clip

citations.quote: Wide shots, medium frames, and close-ups, all consistent, all from one recording.
Create a realistic AI digital twin from a 15 sec video with consistent identity, natural motion, and voice in 175+ languages.
multi-shot prompts, cinematic motion, and scene direction on top of avatar speech
